mapper.select: select date_format(bi.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as d, ifnull(sum(bi.word_count), 0) as value from book_index bi join book b on b.id = bi.book_id where b.author_id = #{authorId} and bi.status = 1 and bi.create_time >= #{start} group by d order by d

select date_format(h.update_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as d, count(distinct h.user_id) as value from user_read_history h join book b on b.id = h.book_id where b.author_id = #{authorId} and h.update_time >= #{start} group by d order by d

select date_format(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') as d, count(*) as value from user_bookshelf s join book b on b.id = s.book_id where b.author_id = #{authorId} and s.create_time >= #{start} group by d order by d

select ifnull(sum(case when bi.status = 0 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as draftCount, ifnull(sum(case when bi.status = 0 then bi.word_count else 0 end), 0) as draftWords, ifnull(sum(case when bi.status = 2 then 1 else 0 end), 0) as scheduleCount from book_index bi join book b on b.id = bi.book_id where b.author_id = #{authorId} and bi.status in (0, 2)

select distinct date_format(bi.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') from book_index bi join book b on b.id = bi.book_id where b.author_id = #{authorId} and bi.status = 1 and bi.create_time >= #{start} order by date_format(bi.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') desc
select count(*) from user_bookshelf s join book b on b.id = s.book_id where b.author_id = #{authorId}
